We disagree with some of the human ratings, e.g., the translation "Elle a été repéré trois jours plus tard par un promeneur de chien piégé dans la carrière" contains grammatical mistakes and changes semantics, and is still scored 6. We present it to illustrate the potential problems of the scoring process.
